decisions.story_title: User Profile Builder WordPress Plugin Authentication Bypass Allows Admin Takeover
decisions.reason: Wordfence disclosure: unauthenticated authentication bypass in the User Profile Builder WordPress plugin (40,000+ active installations) lets attackers log in as user ID 1 (site administrator) when the Automatically Log In setting is enabled, giving full site takeover. Found by Supakiad S. (m3ez) via the Wordfence Bug Bounty Program ($975 bounty). Real vulnerability advisory with substance. Note: mechanically merged into the Funnel Builder story (e1072866878) which is a DIFFERENT plugin and different vulnerability; assigned NEW instead, funnel-builder story json corrected to remove this event.

Personal opinion essay (USENIX Security reflections on AI vulnerability scanning and US intelligence collection going dark); no security event, no vulnerability, no attack, no advisory. Not reportable.
